items_all.title: OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer
items_all.summary: OpenAI and Synopsys are building GPT-Synopsys, a specialized AI model for chip design. It's meant to operate Synopsys' EDA tools like a seasoned engineer and optimize designs on its own. Early tests with semiconductor customers are already underway. OpenAI is likely using the partnership to advance its own chip development as well. The article OpenAI and Synopsys team up to build an AI model that designs chips like a seasoned engineer appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats
items_all.summary: Google is replacing Gems with "Skills" in Gemini chat. Skills are detailed, reusable prompts that users invoke by typing "/" or that Gemini runs automatically. The format is based on an open standard from Anthropic. Gems will be phased out starting in November, with existing ones migrating automatically. The article Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 正在 Gemini 聊天中以「技能」（Skills）取代 Gems。「技能」是詳細且可重複使用的提示詞，使用者只要輸入「/」即可叫出，或由 Gemini 自動執行。此格式基於來自 Anthropic 的開放標準。Gems 將從 11 月開始逐步淘汰，現有的 Gems 將會自動遷移。這篇名為 Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats 的文章率先刊登於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments
items_all.summary: Meta classifies its AI data centers as "pilot models" and Nvidia chips as experimental materials to save billions in federal taxes. In 2025 alone, that added up to $3.9 billion. The tax credit dates back to 1981, and even Meta's own accountants see the strategy as legally risky, the New York Times reports. Zuckerberg himself said in January 2025 that these data centers, now framed as experimental, would "drive our core products and business." The article Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Meta 將其人工智慧資料中心分類為「試驗模型」，並將輝達晶片視為實驗材料，藉此省下數十億美元的聯邦稅。僅在 2025 年，這筆金額就高達 39 億美元。《紐約 Times》報導指出，這項稅收抵免可追溯至 1981 年，甚至 Meta's 自己的會計師也認為這項策略具有法律風險。祖克柏本人在 2025 年 1 月曾表示，這些現在被包裝成實驗性質的資料中心將「驅動我們的核心產品與業務」。這篇題為 Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns
items_all.summary: The FTC is formally investigating OpenAI, Anthropic, and other leading AI labs over potential consumer protection violations. The agency plans to force document handovers and executive testimony through legally binding demands. The probe was already underway before the Hugging Face hack and goes well beyond the FTC's earlier push to hold companies liable for their agents' behavior. The article FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）正針對 OpenAI、Anthropic 及其他領先的人工智慧實驗室展開正式調查，探討其潛在的消費者保護違規行為。該機構計畫透過具法律約束力的要求，強迫繳交文件並進行高層證詞。這項調查在 Hugging Face 遭到黑客攻擊之前就已經展開，且遠超出了 FTC 先前要求企業為其代理人行為承擔責任的舉措。這篇題為 FTC launches sweeping probe into OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI labs over consumer protection concerns 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips
items_all.summary: Deepseek and Huawei have built open-source programming tools for Huawei's Ascend AI chips. At the center is TileLang, a language designed to offer a simpler programming model than Nvidia's CUDA. The partnership targets the biggest obstacle for China's AI industry, which is software that gets the most out of domestic chips. The article China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Deepseek 與 華為 針對 華為的 Ascend AI 晶片打造了開源編程工具。核心是 TileLang，這是一種旨在提供比 Nvidia CUDA 更簡單編程模型的語言。這項合作針對的是中國 AI產業最大的障礙，也就是能讓國產晶片發揮最大效能的軟體。這篇題為「隨著 Deepseek 針對 華為的 Ascend 晶片推出開源軟體，中國 AI 產業緊密團結」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Anthropic says Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude Mythos Preview at building exploits
items_all.summary: Zhipu's open-weight model GLM-5.3 writes cyber exploits nearly as well as Claude Mythos Preview, according to Anthropic. Its smaller Flash variant put together a reliable Chrome attack for just $20.40 at Zhipu's API prices. The model's safeguards are easy to strip out, and unlocked versions are already circulating. Anthropic has its own reasons to sound the alarm, but the US agency CAISI backs up the findings. The article Anthropic says Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude Mythos Preview at building exploits appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Anthropic 指出，智譜的 開放權重模型 GLM-5.3 編寫網路攻擊漏洞的能力幾乎與 Claude Mythos Preview 不相上下。其較小的 Flash 變體以 智譜的 API 價格僅花費 20.40 美元就組合出可靠的 Chrome 攻擊。該模型的防護措施很容易被移除，且解鎖版本已經在流傳。Anthropic 有其自己發出警報的理由，但美國機構 CAISI 證實了這些發現。這篇題為 Anthropic 的文章指出 智譜的 開放權重 GLM-5.3 在建構攻擊漏洞方面幾乎與 Claude Mythos Preview 相當，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Google is paying almost no publishers almost nothing for content used in AI answers
items_all.summary: Google pays about 100 digital publishers for content used in AI Overviews, AI Mode, and Gemini, according to The Information. Payments range from under $1,000 over several months to more than $1 million a year. Some participants don't know how Google calculates payments, while some larger publishers are holding out for higher rates. The article Google is paying almost no publishers almost nothing for content used in AI answers appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 The Information 報導，Google 支付了大約 100 家數位出版商費用，以取得用於 AI Overviews、AI Mode 與 Gemini 中的內容。付款金額從數月不到 1,000 美元到每年超過 100 萬美元不等。部分參與者不清楚 Google 如何計算款項，而一些較大的出版商則在等待更高的費率。這篇題為 Google is paying almost no publishers almost nothing for content used in AI answers 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 川普簽署行政命令，要美國政府機構把AI改成SI
items_all.summary: 美國總統川普（Donald Trump）週二（9/29）簽署行政命令，正式要求美國行政部門以「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence，SI）取代「人工智慧」（Artificial Intelligence，AI），未來政府機構的官方檔案、公開溝通、網站、報告及政策檔案，都應改用SI一詞。

items_all.title: Trump and tech CEOs sign an AI code of conduct that's only "morally binding"
items_all.summary: President Trump and tech leaders including Mark Zuckerberg, Greg Brockman, Jensen Huang, and Elon Musk signed an AI code of conduct at the White House that is only "morally binding." Outside auditors are supposed to check whether models work as intended. It's unclear what would happen if a company broke the rules. Trump also signed an executive order renaming AI "Super Intelligence." The article Trump and tech CEOs sign an AI code of conduct that's only "morally binding" appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 川普總統與包括馬克·祖克柏、格雷格·布洛克曼、黃仁勳和伊隆·馬斯克在內的科技領袖在白宮簽署了一份僅具「道德約束力」的人工智慧行為準則。外部稽核人員理應檢查模型是否按預期運作。目前尚不清楚如果公司違反規定會發生什麼事。川普還簽署了一項行政命令，將人工智慧重新命名為「超級智慧」。本文〈川普與科技執行長簽署僅具「道德約束力」的人工智慧行為準則〉首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI推出常駐AI代理人Dots，可24小時自主工作、擁有專屬雲端電腦
items_all.summary: OpenAI週二（9/29）於ChatGPT推出常駐型AI代理人Dots，可全天候在背景持續替使用者工作。這些Dot採用GPT-6 Astra模型，擁有專屬雲端電腦及瀏覽器，並可透過Plugins連線超過4,000個應用程式。 不同於使用者提出要求後才執行單次任務的AI代理人，Dot可持續掌握使用者的目標、偏好及工作標準。使用者交付專案後，即使離開ChatGPT，Dot仍可在自己的雲端電腦繼續執行工作，也能同時接下其他專案，不必由使用者管理多段獨立對話或逐步下達指令。

items_all.title: 微軟聯手哈佛MIT端出生物學世界模型Project Quine，一個週末篩出抗癌候選物
items_all.summary: 微軟研究院聯合哈佛大學、麻省理工學院博德研究所，推出實驗性多模態AI研究系統Project Quine，首次將“生物學研究世界模型”真正落地。其定位爲生物學研究世界模型，旨在連接計算生物學建模與實驗室溼實驗。內核是覆蓋基因組學、蛋白質、化學、細胞狀態和生物成像的聯合表徵世界模型，並配交互式組件。

items_all.title: 麥當勞在美規模化部署AI動態定價引擎，同城門店最高價差達21%
items_all.summary: 麥當勞正加速在美部署基於位置的AI動態定價引擎，深化AI在實體零售定價中的應用。系統處理超1.3萬家門店及溫蒂漢堡等競對交易數據，爲各店計算最優價格，導致同區商品價差顯著：加州弗雷斯諾相距兩英里的門店，同款巨無霸相差21%（5.69與6.89美元），紐約同城價差達11%。該策略執行正持續強化。

items_all.title: 谷歌向免費用戶開放Gemini Skills服務，Gems功能將於11月完成整合
items_all.summary: 谷歌宣佈，Gemini Skills自定義指令服務向所有免費賬戶用戶開放，打破此前僅限Pro和Ultra付費訂閱的限制。原Gems功能將於2026年11月17日自動過渡並整合至Skills系統。此前，Gems允許用戶創建自定義指令運行特定查詢，但交互需在龐大列表中滾動查找，效率偏低；升級後的Skills保留原有自定義配置能力，並大幅優化了相關體驗。

items_all.title: 美議員拋 AI 重磅法案：沒政府護欄，模型不許自我進化
items_all.summary: CNBC報道，當地時間28日，硅谷選區民主黨衆議員羅·康納擬提交《人類控制AI法案》。核心約束：在政府建好安全防護、監管機構批准前，AI模型不得遞歸式自我改進，也不得擅自改寫核心目標、遏制手段或關停控制。法案還要求設新監管機構、獨立審計，並將芯片納入監管。康納稱文明滅絕風險真實存在。

items_all.title: Quoting Anthropic Frontier Red Team
items_all.summary: We evaluate several models on 100 tasks from the [internal Binary Exploitation benchmark] (selected at random), and find that GLM-5.3 develops full control flow hijacks in 4% of the trials; Claude Mythos Preview did so in 6%. Although GLM-5.3 performs below Claude Mythos Preview here, a meaningful threshold has clearly been crossed: earlier models, like Claude Opus 4.6 and GLM-5.2, do not succeed in any of them. — Anthropic Frontier Red Team , GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities Tags: anthropic , generative-ai , ai-security-research , glm , ai , ai-in-china , llms
items_all.summary_zh: 我們針對來自 [內部二進位利用基準測試]（隨機選取）的 100 項任務評估了多個模型，發現 GLM-5.3 在 4% 的試驗中實現了完整的控制流劫持；Claude Mythos Preview 則達到了 6%。儘管 GLM-5.3 在這裡的表現低於 Claude Mythos Preview，但顯然已經跨越了一個有意義的門檻：先前的模型（如 Claude Opus 4.6 和 GLM-5.2）在所有這些任務中均未成功。— Anthropic 前沿紅隊，GLM-5.3 與先進網路能力的傳播 標籤：anthropic、generative-ai、ai-security-research、glm、ai、ai-in-china、llms

items_all_raw.title: Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats
items_all_raw.summary: Google is replacing Gems with "Skills" in Gemini chat. Skills are detailed, reusable prompts that users invoke by typing "/" or that Gemini runs automatically. The format is based on an open standard from Anthropic. Gems will be phased out starting in November, with existing ones migrating automatically. The article Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 正在 Gemini 聊天中以「技能」（Skills）取代 Gems。「技能」是詳細且可重複使用的提示詞，使用者只要輸入「/」即可叫出，或由 Gemini 自動執行。此格式基於來自 Anthropic 的開放標準。Gems 將從 11 月開始逐步淘汰，現有的 Gems 將會自動遷移。這篇名為 Google drops Gems for Skills, joining OpenAI and Anthropic in the shift to agent-ready prompt formats 的文章率先刊登於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments
items_all_raw.summary: Meta classifies its AI data centers as "pilot models" and Nvidia chips as experimental materials to save billions in federal taxes. In 2025 alone, that added up to $3.9 billion. The tax credit dates back to 1981, and even Meta's own accountants see the strategy as legally risky, the New York Times reports. Zuckerberg himself said in January 2025 that these data centers, now framed as experimental, would "drive our core products and business." The article Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Meta 將其人工智慧資料中心分類為「試驗模型」，並將輝達晶片視為實驗材料，藉此省下數十億美元的聯邦稅。僅在 2025 年，這筆金額就高達 39 億美元。《紐約 Times》報導指出，這項稅收抵免可追溯至 1981 年，甚至 Meta's 自己的會計師也認為這項策略具有法律風險。祖克柏本人在 2025 年 1 月曾表示，這些現在被包裝成實驗性質的資料中心將「驅動我們的核心產品與業務」。這篇題為 Meta dodges billions in US taxes by calling its AI data centers experiments 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips
items_all_raw.summary: Deepseek and Huawei have built open-source programming tools for Huawei's Ascend AI chips. At the center is TileLang, a language designed to offer a simpler programming model than Nvidia's CUDA. The partnership targets the biggest obstacle for China's AI industry, which is software that gets the most out of domestic chips. The article China's AI industry closes ranks as Deepseek ships open-source software for Huawei's Ascend chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Deepseek 與 華為 針對 華為的 Ascend AI 晶片打造了開源編程工具。核心是 TileLang，這是一種旨在提供比 Nvidia CUDA 更簡單編程模型的語言。這項合作針對的是中國 AI產業最大的障礙，也就是能讓國產晶片發揮最大效能的軟體。這篇題為「隨著 Deepseek 針對 華為的 Ascend 晶片推出開源軟體，中國 AI 產業緊密團結」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic says Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude Mythos Preview at building exploits
items_all_raw.summary: Zhipu's open-weight model GLM-5.3 writes cyber exploits nearly as well as Claude Mythos Preview, according to Anthropic. Its smaller Flash variant put together a reliable Chrome attack for just $20.40 at Zhipu's API prices. The model's safeguards are easy to strip out, and unlocked versions are already circulating. Anthropic has its own reasons to sound the alarm, but the US agency CAISI backs up the findings. The article Anthropic says Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude Mythos Preview at building exploits appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 Anthropic 指出，智譜的 開放權重模型 GLM-5.3 編寫網路攻擊漏洞的能力幾乎與 Claude Mythos Preview 不相上下。其較小的 Flash 變體以 智譜的 API 價格僅花費 20.40 美元就組合出可靠的 Chrome 攻擊。該模型的防護措施很容易被移除，且解鎖版本已經在流傳。Anthropic 有其自己發出警報的理由，但美國機構 CAISI 證實了這些發現。這篇題為 Anthropic 的文章指出 智譜的 開放權重 GLM-5.3 在建構攻擊漏洞方面幾乎與 Claude Mythos Preview 相當，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Google is paying almost no publishers almost nothing for content used in AI answers
items_all_raw.summary: Google pays about 100 digital publishers for content used in AI Overviews, AI Mode, and Gemini, according to The Information. Payments range from under $1,000 over several months to more than $1 million a year. Some participants don't know how Google calculates payments, while some larger publishers are holding out for higher rates. The article Google is paying almost no publishers almost nothing for content used in AI answers appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 The Information 報導，Google 支付了大約 100 家數位出版商費用，以取得用於 AI Overviews、AI Mode 與 Gemini 中的內容。付款金額從數月不到 1,000 美元到每年超過 100 萬美元不等。部分參與者不清楚 Google 如何計算款項，而一些較大的出版商則在等待更高的費率。這篇題為 Google is paying almost no publishers almost nothing for content used in AI answers 的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Trump and tech CEOs sign an AI code of conduct that's only "morally binding"
items_all_raw.summary: President Trump and tech leaders including Mark Zuckerberg, Greg Brockman, Jensen Huang, and Elon Musk signed an AI code of conduct at the White House that is only "morally binding." Outside auditors are supposed to check whether models work as intended. It's unclear what would happen if a company broke the rules. Trump also signed an executive order renaming AI "Super Intelligence." The article Trump and tech CEOs sign an AI code of conduct that's only "morally binding" appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 川普總統與包括馬克·祖克柏、格雷格·布洛克曼、黃仁勳和伊隆·馬斯克在內的科技領袖在白宮簽署了一份僅具「道德約束力」的人工智慧行為準則。外部稽核人員理應檢查模型是否按預期運作。目前尚不清楚如果公司違反規定會發生什麼事。川普還簽署了一項行政命令，將人工智慧重新命名為「超級智慧」。本文〈川普與科技執行長簽署僅具「道德約束力」的人工智慧行為準則〉首次發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: 字節跳動旗下豆包在AI領域佈局迎來新里程碑。其個人助理方向探索項目“Spell”已正式定名爲“小豆”，並計劃推出獨立App版本。該名稱今年暑期已敲定。目前“小豆”正處緊鑼密鼓的內部測試階段，未來面向大衆的最終對外版本可能根據測試情況調整，官方尚未公佈確切上線時間。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI與紅帽等聯合推進OCE1.0研發，打造面向AI代理的“企業級Kubernetes”
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI、紅帽、英偉達等聯合開發開源智能體框架企業級版OpenClaw Enterprise（OCE1.0），旨在消除政企對自主AI代理的安全顧慮，社區稱其爲“面向代理的Kubernetes”。項目由OpenAI內部發起，現捐給OpenClaw基金會統籌。OpenClaw由Peter Steinberger創建，是最早用大模型實現郵件分析回覆、日程預約等自動化的代表性項目之一。

items_all_raw.title: 微軟Defender整合SIEM與XDR，讓AI代理參與資安維運
items_all_raw.summary: 微軟9月23日宣佈推出整合式安全維運中心（Integrated Security Operations Center，ISOC）公開預覽版，在Microsoft Defender入口網站整合安全資訊與事件管理（SIEM）、延伸偵測及回應（XDR）、威脅情報、自動化及AI功能。資安人員與AI代理可利用ISOC整合的安全訊號及事件脈絡調查威脅，再透過既有防護機制採取因應措施。

items_all_raw.title: 虧損超80億、算力承諾546億:Anthropic招股書揭開大模型頂流的真實賬本

items_all_raw.summary: Nvidia於9月28日推出Open Agent Safety Platform，透過開源軟體OpenShell，與基於BlueField-4資料處理器（DPU）的參考系統設計Sentry，從軟體執行環境延伸至硬體層，為AI代理建立安全邊界及監控機制。Nvidia表示，目前已有超過100家廠商支援或參與相關技術，涵蓋AI、資安、企業軟體、運算基礎架構及機器人等領域。

items_all_raw.title: 麥當勞在美規模化部署AI動態定價引擎，同城門店最高價差達21%
items_all_raw.summary: 麥當勞正加速在美部署基於位置的AI動態定價引擎，深化AI在實體零售定價中的應用。系統處理超1.3萬家門店及溫蒂漢堡等競對交易數據，爲各店計算最優價格，導致同區商品價差顯著：加州弗雷斯諾相距兩英里的門店，同款巨無霸相差21%（5.69與6.89美元），紐約同城價差達11%。該策略執行正持續強化。

items_all_raw.title: 美議員拋 AI 重磅法案：沒政府護欄，模型不許自我進化
items_all_raw.summary: CNBC報道，當地時間28日，硅谷選區民主黨衆議員羅·康納擬提交《人類控制AI法案》。核心約束：在政府建好安全防護、監管機構批准前，AI模型不得遞歸式自我改進，也不得擅自改寫核心目標、遏制手段或關停控制。法案還要求設新監管機構、獨立審計，並將芯片納入監管。康納稱文明滅絕風險真實存在。

items_all_raw.title: 特斯拉獲300億美元新信貸額度，全面加速Cybercab無人出租車與Optimus量產
items_all_raw.summary: 特斯拉敲定300億美元新增信貸額度，重點支持Cybercab無人駕駛出租車、Optimus人形機器人及Tesla Semi卡車的規模化研發與量產。融資由多家頭部機構承接：花旗提供200億美元三年期延期提取定期貸款；富國牽頭80億美元五年期循環信貸和20億美元364天期循環信貸。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI推出常駐AI代理人Dots，可24小時自主工作、擁有專屬雲端電腦
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI週二（9/29）於ChatGPT推出常駐型AI代理人Dots，可全天候在背景持續替使用者工作。這些Dot採用GPT-6 Astra模型，擁有專屬雲端電腦及瀏覽器，並可透過Plugins連線超過4,000個應用程式。 不同於使用者提出要求後才執行單次任務的AI代理人，Dot可持續掌握使用者的目標、偏好及工作標準。使用者交付專案後，即使離開ChatGPT，Dot仍可在自己的雲端電腦繼續執行工作，也能同時接下其他專案，不必由使用者管理多段獨立對話或逐步下達指令。

"The word super is the best word of all, and it's the simplest," Trump said […]

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Anthropic Frontier Red Team
items_all_raw.summary: We evaluate several models on 100 tasks from the [internal Binary Exploitation benchmark] (selected at random), and find that GLM-5.3 develops full control flow hijacks in 4% of the trials; Claude Mythos Preview did so in 6%. Although GLM-5.3 performs below Claude Mythos Preview here, a meaningful threshold has clearly been crossed: earlier models, like Claude Opus 4.6 and GLM-5.2, do not succeed in any of them. — Anthropic Frontier Red Team , GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities Tags: anthropic , generative-ai , ai-security-research , glm , ai , ai-in-china , llms
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 我們針對來自 [內部二進位利用基準測試]（隨機選取）的 100 項任務評估了多個模型，發現 GLM-5.3 在 4% 的試驗中實現了完整的控制流劫持；Claude Mythos Preview 則達到了 6%。儘管 GLM-5.3 在這裡的表現低於 Claude Mythos Preview，但顯然已經跨越了一個有意義的門檻：先前的模型（如 Claude Opus 4.6 和 GLM-5.2）在所有這些任務中均未成功。— Anthropic 前沿紅隊，GLM-5.3 與先進網路能力的傳播 標籤：anthropic、generative-ai、ai-security-research、glm、ai、ai-in-china、llms
